findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference still leaves non-essential motion running
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched, the evaluate probe still found a running 800 ms animation plus multiple 0.2–0.5 s transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or substantially shorten non-essential animations and transitions inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: A full-page cookie dialog interrupts every first visit
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360 px screenshots show the consent dialog obscuring the entire feed before any interaction; the mobile dialog consumes nearly the full viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-obscuring consent surface where legally possible, preserve equal accept/decline choices, and remember the decision immediately.

findings.summary: Consent and promotional overlays are custom div dialogs
findings.evidence: DOM probes found zero native dialog/popover/details elements; consent is a div with role=dialog and its actions are div role=button controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/showModal() for modal consent and native button elements for actions, with an accessible name and platform focus/dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Feed chrome does not expose scroll-state feedback
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll timeline or scroll-state behavior; desktop and mobile captures show static navigation with no progress or state-aware header treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add subtle scroll-state feedback only where it improves orientation, using declarative scroll-state/container techniques rather than scroll handlers.

findings.summary: Several focusable controls have invisible focus and tiny geometry
findings.evidence: The focus probe reported many anchors and role=button controls with outline-style none; panorama buttons measured only 10 px wide, below a usable touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native controls, add a clearly visible :focus-visible treatment, and provide at least a 44×44 CSS px activation area.

findings.summary: Search and unknown-route states do not explain what happened
findings.evidence: A submitted search navigated to a query URL but exposed only the query and footer after 2.5 s, with no loading/empty guidance; an unknown URL silently redirected to login instead of a clear not-found state.
findings.suggestedFix: Render explicit loading, empty, error, and 404 states with retry, edit-query, home, and back actions while preserving context.

findings.summary: Initial rendering is extremely slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 7.0 s, LCP 16.2 s, Speed Index 13.9 s and performance score 0.30; the raw CDP trace independently measured FCP 6.70 s and LCP 11.34 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the feed LCP resource, reduce startup payload, and defer non-critical scripts/media until after primary content.

findings.summary: The loading experience produces a severe layout shift
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 1.0 and reported one large layout shift, far above the 0.1 good threshold, although the settled mobile primitive observed no later shifts.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve exact space for consent/promo/feed content and prevent late state swaps from moving the primary viewport.

findings.summary: The anonymous feed has a heavy and slow critical delivery path
findings.evidence: HAR captured 105 requests and 3,191,522 transferred bytes; 29 scripts transferred 1.52 MB and the parser-inserted stylesheet took 5.20 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce critical dependencies, split anonymous-feed bundles, inline only critical CSS, and preload only confirmed LCP-critical resources.

findings.summary: Most shipped CSS and substantial JavaScript are unused on the audited view
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 871 KiB unused JavaScript and 103 KiB unused CSS, including 96.5% of the main stylesheet.
findings.suggestedFix: Produce an anonymous-feed entry bundle, remove duplicate/legacy modules, and load interaction code conditionally.

findings.summary: Dialogs and media lack accessible names or alternatives
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed role=dialog; the image primitive found five of eleven images without alt text, including content imagery.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every dialog with aria-labelledby/aria-label and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative media.

findings.summary: Muted text fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found timestamps at 4.24:1 on #101010 and promo copy at 3.96:1 on #181818, below the required 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise muted-text luminance or adjust its surface token so all normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 in each theme.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not consistently visible
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus on navigation and feed controls repeatedly produced outline-style none and no box shadow; the DOM also relies heavily on generic div role=button controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and replace generic clickable divs with native links/buttons in logical DOM order.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is restricted and some targets are too small
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because maximum-scale was below 5; the probe also found 10 px-wide focusable panorama controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale restrictions and enlarge narrow controls without changing their visual footprint.

findings.summary: Document and image hygiene has avoidable defects
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported a missing/late charset; image inspection found seven oversized images and nine legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Place UTF-8 charset first in head and serve correctly sized AVIF/WebP variants with responsive sources.

findings.summary: A deprecated unload listener harms platform hygiene and BFCache readiness
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported an unload event listener in the primary Instagram CDN bundle, an API Chrome is removing.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange where required and avoid unload entirely for telemetry.

findings.summary: The home feed and thread content are largely absent without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 6% raw-HTML coverage on home (isJsShell=true) and 16% on the thread detail; the crawler screenshots expose far less content than rendered views.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render meaningful feed/thread content and crawlable anchors, then hydrate interactions progressively.

findings.summary: Rich public entities have social metadata but no structured data
findings.evidence: Profile and thread probes found useful Open Graph metadata but zero JSON-LD blocks for ProfilePage/Person or SocialMediaPosting entities.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD that matches visible public profile and post content.

findings.summary: Security policy has avoidable gaps
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS, HSTS and CSP, but style-src allows unsafe-inline, Referrer-Policy is absent, and the 400-day csrftoken uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Move styles behind hashes/nonces, set a strict Referrer-Policy, and narrow the CSRF cookie scope/SameSite/retention where cross-site use is not essential.

findings.summary: Core public content depends heavily on JavaScript
findings.evidence: Raw server HTML retained only 6% of rendered home words and 16% on the thread detail, leaving important public content unavailable to non-JS and failure conditions.
findings.suggestedFix: Render core feed/thread text and navigation in server HTML, then layer reactions, media controls, and transitions as enhancements.

findings.summary: The app manifest is present but the page is not controlled for offline use
findings.evidence: A valid standalone manifest and icons exist, but the runtime probe found no active service-worker controller on the app-like home experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a service worker that provides a bounded offline shell and a clear offline fallback for previously viewed content.

findings.summary: Unknown routes fail into an unrelated login screen
findings.evidence: The intentionally unknown public URL redirected to /login/?next=... with no 404 explanation, recovery action, or indication that the requested resource does not exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Return the correct HTTP status and a resilient not-found screen with home/search/back recovery actions.

findings.summary: Empty login submission gives no explicit accessible feedback
findings.evidence: After empty submission, focus moved to the username field but the probe found no :invalid elements, aria-invalid state, alert or live-region message.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, mark the field invalid, and announce a concise corrective message in an aria-live region.

findings.summary: Images are frequently oversized, legacy-format, and eagerly loaded
findings.evidence: Image inspection found seven oversized images, nine legacy-format images and seven below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive AVIF/WebP sources and lazy-load below-fold media while keeping the first visible post eager and prioritised.

findings.summary: Anonymous browsing transfers a disproportionate third-party/media payload
findings.evidence: HAR attributed 3.02 MB and 87 of 105 requests to CDN origins outside www.threads.com, including 1.27 MB of images and media fetched during initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an anonymous-feed byte budget, defer below-fold media, and fetch only the first viewport until the user scrolls.

taskList.title: Make the anonymous feed fast and stable
Server-render public feed and thread content
Repair accessible dialogs, focus, contrast, zoom and media alternatives
Replace the blocking consent experience with semantic, labelled controls
Add explicit empty, 404 and login-error recovery states
Harden browser security policy and cookie scope
Add an offline fallback and active service worker
Clean up deprecated APIs, charset and asset markup
Respect reduced motion and improve navigation feedback
Add structured data for profiles and posts
